notes: STEVE WHITE, 2020, modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20', ENTIRELY HANDWRITTEN in blue ballpoint over the born-digital fillable blank. FOUR pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates'), p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' LAST — the addendum-I3 shape, confirmed by content rather than by ordinal. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound into this filing: there is exactly ONE page carrying the summary labels (p4) and it carries figures in every box. Page-face candidate 'STEVE WHITE' agrees with the channel label; the page-face Office box reads 'COMMISSION C' while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C' — the same seat, and no seat was inferred. Report type: the filled radio is '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination'; 'Is this report an amendment?' is marked No. INTRA-DOCUMENT DATE DISCREPANCY, recorded and not adjudicated (addendum D6): the signature Date box reads 5/14/2020 while the clerk's RECEIVED stamp reads MAY 13 2020 and the county's filename says 05.15.20. Box A (balance at beginning) is a SLASHED ZERO — 0 under the zero-glyph ruling; the unlettered final box 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)' prints '-$172.48' with the minus sign written outside the dollar sign, and the NEGATIVE IS REAL (2,000.00 - 2,172.48). SCHEDULE B ON THIS FORM HAS A REAL PURPOSE COLUMN (Date / Provider-Vendor / Purpose / Amount) and every one of the 13 rows fills it — captured per addendum I3. The Date/Name/Address columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen, CHUNK_BRIEF section 7): every date cell holds a date, every name cell a person or company, every address cell a redaction bar over a city/state/zip line, and on Schedule B every purpose cell holds a purpose — no inversion. All six row-index traps were screened: the first written entry is in band 1 on both schedules (crop-proved), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, nothing below the last printed rule, and no doubled band (both grids are uniform-pitch, and every band was accounted for by the exact closure).
